# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# Expectation for the doctor check `node_layout` (DESIGN.md §7.1) against input/.
# The layout rules are §2i's table; the fixture seam (FMONERO_PROC_ROOT, FMONERO_SYSTEMCTL_FIXTURE,
# honoured only when FMONERO_STATE_DIR is also set) is §2i's test-seam paragraph.
#
# HOW TO READ THIS FILE
#   `_env`      environment the case needs. Values are paths RELATIVE TO THIS CASE DIRECTORY; the
#               harness makes them absolute. FMONERO_STATE_DIR is always required for the other two
#               to be honoured, and its value is the harness's own temp dir, so it is not listed.
#   `_settings` settings keys the case needs, as dotted key -> value. THE HARNESS WRITES THEM INTO
#               config.toml DIRECTLY, not through `fmonero settings set`: node_layout__remote needs a
#               non-loopback node.url, and `settings set node.url` refuses one outright with exit 2
#               reason non_loopback_url (§2c). A case that cannot be set up through the CLI is exactly
#               the case worth fixturing.
#   the rest   the subset of the §7 check object this fixture pins: {id, group, severity, class,
#               status, fixable} exactly, plus `detail_contains` -- substrings the detail must
#               contain, NOT the whole detail string. Pinning prose would make the fixture fail on a
#               reworded message, which is the check nobody keeps.
#
# THIS CASE: Layout::UserUnit, the healthy fmonero-owned layout.
# status `pass`: node_layout is an INFO-severity, class-D report of what was found (§7.1), and
# user_unit is the layout fmonero is designed for, so the detail names it and nothing is wrong.
# OWNERSHIP: DESIGN.md §8 hands tests/fixtures/doctor/** to the Phase 2 doctor agent, which may edit
# these files. Where a status here is Phase 0's reading of §7.1 rather than a quotation from it, this
# file says so, so that agent can disagree with a reason instead of guessing.
# EDITED BY THE PHASE 2 DOCTOR AGENT (DESIGN.md §8 hands this directory to it): see
# decisions/phase2-doctor.md for the reason, stated case by case.
# ADDED `_probe.monerod_installed`: every check in the `node` group reports
# skip:monerod_not_installed when /usr/bin/monerod is absent, which is §4b's GREEN row for
# this machine and §7.1's "every check whose precondition is missing reports skip:<reason>".
# No file under input/ can carry that fact, so the harness states it here.
# v5.6 (§2o): `node_layout`'s DETAIL is now plain language and the check's `id`, `group`,
# `severity`, `class`, `status` and `fixable` are unchanged -- which is the whole point of the
# rewrite: `--json` is the agent contract and this fixture pins it. What changed is the prose,
# so `detail_contains` names the words a person now reads. The internal layout words
# (`user_unit`, `system_unit`, `remote`, `none`), the trust flag and the ssl mode are gone from
# every human surface and stay in the payload.
